name: streamshare-public-workspace
description: Controlled public distribution workspace for the StreamShare developer ecosystem

scripts.ci: pnpm run test && pnpm run docs:typecheck && pnpm run security:docs-assets && pnpm run docs:build && pnpm exec changeset status && pnpm run audit:prod
scripts.release:check: pnpm run ci && pnpm --filter @streamshare/plugin-sdk release:check && pnpm --filter @streamshare/plugin-cli release:check && pnpm --filter @streamshare/service release:check && pnpm --filter @streamshare/remote-protocol release:check
